images.prompt: Photorealistic premium Diwali festival background for a tall phone status poster, with NO people and NO text. Deep navy blue to dark teal softly lit backdrop with warm golden bokeh lights and a string of small warm fairy lights and a marigold-and-mango-leaf toran hanging across the very top. Along the bottom 25%: a festive arrangement on a low surface, with a row of glowing clay diyas with steady flames, orange and yellow marigolds, rose petals, a small brass urli with floating flowers and a simple colourful rangoli pattern in front, softly lit. The middle and right side are calm, dark and uncluttered, so a person and text can be placed there later. Warm light from the left, elegant and joyful. One continuous full-bleed scene, no bands, borders or panels, no letters, no logos, no deity faces, no firecrackers.
